prompt:
透明背景。Draw ONE NEW complete whole-body arcade pixel sprite of Ultraman Arc LUNA ARMOR, BACKSTEP PHASE 03/04. Fixed side-view camera, person facing SCREEN RIGHT. One complete person and one distinct phase.
IMAGE 1 is the NEW COMPLETE PLANNED POSE GUIDE. IMAGE 2 is the accepted LUNA IDENTITY MASTER and the target final guarding leg order. Follow image 1 for the absolute new full-body pose and image 2 for identity, anatomy, complete armor, depth colors, proportions and pixel finish. No old three-leg person or wrong final-leg source is attached.
Permanent depth identity: WHITE guide chain is the NEAR left limb, rendered BRIGHT SILVER; DARK guide chain is the FAR right limb, rendered DARK SILVER. Trace each entire shoulder-elbow-wrist-fist and hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-boot chain. Never exchange a limb identity when its screen position changes. Exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs and TWO boots, connected to one torso. No duplicated shin, third leg, extra foot, ghost image or multiple poses in one person.
This is the LANDING FOLLOW-THROUGH of a backward step. Draw exactly TWO complete legs and TWO boots. The lifted BRIGHT NEAR knee from the preceding phase folds down and the entire bright near leg withdraws to screen LEFT/behind the hip, with its near boot now coming down in the rear position. The DARK FAR leg is the screen-RIGHT/front support for the recovered fighting stance: knee flexed, its whole dark boot planted slightly in front of the hips. Keep each hip-thigh-knee-shin-ankle-boot chain continuous and distinct; no third leg, duplicated shin, extra shoe, echo limb or motion ghost. Both knees absorb the landing, hips and shoulders settle together, the near forearm comes forward across the lower chest and the far fist rises toward the face. This is a complete person in one new landing pose, not two leg positions overlaid.
Redraw the ENTIRE PERSON together in this new phase. Preserve image 2's low swept silver head crest and opening, yellow eye, cyan chest lamp, ice-blue moon chest/shoulder armor, both circular wrist disks, red/silver suit patterns and natural complete body volume. Do not paste, rotate, cut, swap, locally recolor or reuse a limb. Do not paste armor onto another body or place an effect over a static person.
Keep natural continuous suit surfaces across shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles. No toy ball joints, insertion gaps, screws, mold seams, stands or plastic highlights; keep the character's designed armor segmentation. Match the master's head/body proportions without enlarging the head or torso to fill the square. The source is one complete high-resolution image for later common 1024-to-159 whole-image sampling, never per-limb scaling.
Crisp 32-color arcade pixel clusters, stepped dark outlines, upper-left light, no photo texture, soft blur, smooth vector finish or realistic metal. Full head, both complete hands, BOTH complete boots and all armor tips inside generous transparent margins. No clipping, horizontal/vertical stretching, ground shadow or ground plane.
True RGBA transparent PNG, 1024x1024, high quality. No background, checkerboard, ground line, labels, grids, guide, skeleton, other people, weapons, speed lines, beam or Q/charge effects. 背景必须真Alpha透明，不画棋盘格。
